title: Docker Containerization for Python Apps (PYTH_158_S1 to PYTH_158_S8)

slides.title: Containerization Fundamentals
slides.prompt: Docker packages Python code and all system dependencies into isolated, reproducible container images.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Example Dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt

slides.title: Multi-Stage Docker Builds
slides.prompt: Why are multi-stage Docker builds recommended for Python production images?
options: They significantly reduce final image size by discarding build tools and compilers
They allow running multiple web servers inside one container
They eliminate the need for requirements.txt
slides.correctAnswer: They significantly reduce final image size by discarding build tools and compilers
